fingerprints.prevent: Use accepted semantic/navigation baseline, not chronology, and block production on unexpected semantic drift.
Start from accepted baseline, diff once, restore only proven drift, preserve non-conflicting technical improvements.
Keep one canonical shell and explicitly materialize it for source-based CI consumers.
assets/js/menu.js is the sole mobile behavior owner; do not add a second drawer/controller.
Make runtime/source representation transforms explicit and deterministic; never weaken the checker to hide representation drift.
Restored routes need logical incoming internal links in addition to route existence.
Test business/architecture invariants at the canonical owner; do not enforce obsolete copy-paste implementations.
Read the exact red gate, isolate one concrete failure, apply minimum root-cause fix, rerun same candidate scope.
Refresh base before state-dependent writes/merge; exact SHA is release identity; synchronize only on real overlap/dependency conflict.
Use PR metadata actions for administrative changes; avoid source no-op commits that trigger new CI/Netlify work.

fast_path_rules: one diff and route inventory before edits
preview does not equal production acceptance
green means outcome verified, not merely technical success
write every material new failure/fix/prevention back to shared memory
agent_instruction: Before related website, SEO, GitHub, Netlify or recovery work, fingerprint-match this learning set and the development ledger. Reuse proven fixes and gates before inventing new recovery paths.
